title: [Bugs] AMF fails to decode Registration Request(GUTI) after restart
rationale: After AMF restart the lost NAS security context makes the AMF fail to decode GUTI registration instead of falling back.

title: [Bugs] The UE will not reconnect if the AMF reboots without sending a deregistration to the UE.
rationale: A restarted AMF forgets UEs and silently drops their Service Requests; UEs never re-register.

title: [Bugs] Re-association starvation with 2 connected UPFs
rationale: After a heartbeat-detected UPF failure the SMF's PFCP re-association never completes (responses not processed).

title: [Bugs] SMF reports "IP is used" and "UE IP pool exhausted" after gNB CU/DU restart
rationale: After gNB CU/DU restart the SMF retains the UE's old IP allocation; 'IP is used' and eventually 'UE IP pool exhausted'.

title: [Bugs] SMF Resource Exhaustion via PFCP Session Establishment Failure Handling
rationale: When the UPF does not answer Session Establishment, resources allocated for the failed attempt are never released.

title: [Bugs] SMContext leaked when GetTokenCtx fails during SM context create; empty 200 leaves the AMF with no smContextRef to release it
rationale: During an NRF outage every SM context create leaks an SMContext the AMF has no smContextRef to release.

title: [Bugs]Duplicate SM context is never released when PFCP session deletion fails; each UE retry orphans one SMContext and one UE IP
rationale: When PFCP session deletion fails the duplicate SM context is never released; each retry orphans an SMContext and a UE IP.

title: [Bugs] SMF: local release leaves a charging session open on the CHF when the PFCP session deletion fails
rationale: When PFCP session deletion fails, local release leaves the CHF charging session open and the SMContext half-released.

title: [Bugs] AMF NGAP worker permanently lost after handler panic, no restart mechanism
rationale: A panicking NGAP worker is never restarted while its queue keeps accepting messages, which silently vanish.

title: Bug: PDU Session Establishment fails after AMF pod restart due to stale CommunicationClient
rationale: After an AMF pod restart the SMF keeps a stale CommunicationClient; N1N2MessageTransfer hangs for all UEs until SMF restart.

title: UE IP allocation walks outside the configured pool after SMF restarts (SMF_COUNT stride is unbounded)
root_cause_detail: restart-counter stride replaces lost allocation map
rationale: IP allocator strides by a restart counter persisted in MongoDB; after restarts it silently hands out addresses outside the routed pool.

title: After restarting sgw the UE cann't attah again
rationale: After an SGW restart the MME keeps using TEIDs the SGW no longer knows; the UE cannot attach again.

title: MME Restarts if SGs Interface is Down
rationale: With the SGs peer unreachable the MME restarts whenever a UE attaches.

title: NRF closes HTTP socket if any unregistered NF sends Heartbeat and then Registration request
rationale: After an NRF restart (empty cache) a heartbeat from a still-running NF makes the NRF close the socket and later crash.

title: AMF crashes when gNB with 40+ connected UE's disconnects
rationale: Disconnecting a gNB with 40+ UEs makes the AMF crash while tearing down their contexts.

title: SMF Fatal Error v2.2.9 - Invalid Downlink Data Service Information
root_cause_detail: peers keep state after SMF restart
rationale: After the SMF crashes and restarts, all NFs must be restarted to become operative again.

title: feedback requested: PFCP synchronization?
rationale: UPF restart loses all PFCP state while SMF/SGW-C keep sessions; attached UEs have no traffic until the CP is restarted.

title: SMF Number Of Sessions Not Updating After UEs Have Been Deleted
rationale: After the gNB and UEs are removed the AMF reflects reality but the SMF keeps the sessions active.

title: [AMF] NG_Reset in response for UE_Context_Release_Command causes a fatal error (crash)
rationale: An NG Reset received in response to UE Context Release Command crashes the AMF.

title: [Bug]: [SMF]  smf_npcf_smpolicycontrol_build_delete: Assertion sess->sm_context_ref failed
rationale: Shutting down the host running the UPFs/SGWs makes the SMF crash (assertion on sm_context_ref) instead of failing sessions.

title: [Bug]: UPF HA - PDU session is not released/established in CM_IDLE
rationale: With UPF HA, killing the UPF while the UE is CM-IDLE leaves the PDU session neither released nor re-established.

title: handling of "No established PFCP Association"
rationale: UPF loses its association/contexts; SMF keeps sending session requests rejected with 'No established PFCP Association' until SMF restart.

title: [Bug]: Incomplete NF Instance Cleanup Due to Reference Counting Error Causes Fallback to Default Port 80 After UDR Restart
rationale: After a UDR restart the UDM keeps a stale NF-instance/client (refcount error) and falls back to port 80; registrations fail.

title: [Bug]: AMF fails to handle GOAWAY frames and reuses a closed tcp stream
rationale: After a UDM GOAWAY the AMF keeps reusing the closed HTTP/2 connection and subsequent requests fail.

title: gtpu TEID Issue - EPC Fail over recovery
rationale: After the main EPC restarts and the eNB fails back, the UE re-attaches but its user-plane traffic is dropped.

title: AMF/SMF stale UE context after gNB SCTP reconnection causes PDU session failure (HTTP 400)
rationale: After gNB SCTP reconnection AMF/SMF keep stale UE context; N1N2 transfers fail with HTTP 400 and the UE stays registered without data.

title: AMF UE Context Resource Leak After SCTP Disconnection During Incomplete Registration
rationale: Repeated SCTP closes during incomplete registration leak AMF UE contexts until the pool is exhausted.

title: [Bug]: GTP-U Error Indication on S5-U tears down the whole IMS PDN without notifying the MME (VoLTE UE stuck until re-attach)
rationale: On a GTP-U Error Indication the SGW/PGW locally deletes the IMS PDN without notifying the MME; UE stuck until re-attach.

title: [Bug]: Repeated GTP-U Error Indications can crash SMF during EPC bearer deactivation
rationale: Two Error Indication reports for one bearer start two deactivation procedures and crash the SMF.

title: SBI client never recovers from a half-dead HTTP/2 connection (requests keep timing out forever)
rationale: After the peer stops answering on an established HTTP/2 connection the SBI client keeps reusing it; requests time out forever.

title: [Bug]: SMF aborts on PFCP Session Deletion timeout when the associated SBI stream is gone (sess_5gc_timeout: Assertion 'stream' failed)
rationale: SMF aborts on PFCP Session Deletion timeout; on restart it loses UE IP allocations, causing duplicate IPs and broken downlink.

title: [Bug]: SMF: not releasing existing UE sessions after UPF failure (Heartbeat timeout)
rationale: SMF never releases UE sessions after the only UPF is declared failed via heartbeat timeout.

title: [Bug]: UPF: not releasing existing UE sessions after SMF failure (Heartbeat timeout)
rationale: UPF keeps session contexts after SMF heartbeat timeout, violating TS 23.527 clause 4.4.3.1.

title: [Bug]: SMF PFCP restoration re-installs stale UE IPs after UPF restart (silent downlink black-hole)
rationale: After a UPF restart the SMF restores PDRs keyed on the UE's old IP; downlink for the new IP is silently dropped.

title: AMF: SMF discovery failure in PDU session establishment may accumulate AMF PDU session contexts  #1
rationale: When SMF selection fails the AMF keeps the PDU session context it registered; contexts accumulate.

title: Mobile reachable timer is not started when only the NGAP context is released
rationale: When a gNB restarts/resets, the AMF releases only the NGAP context and never starts the mobile reachable timer, so the UE is never implicitly deregistered.

title: A restarted SMF reuses SM context references, so an old reference from the AMF releases another UE's PDU session
rationale: Restarted SMF restarts its smContextRef counter at 0; the AMF's stale reference resolves to another UE's SM context and releases it.

title: UPF keeps the PFCP sessions of an association when the same CP function sets it up again
rationale: Association re-setup by the same CP function overwrites the association but keeps the old PFCP sessions, TEIDs and UE IPs.

title: [Bugs] UPF leaks PfcpXact if PFCP Session Report Response is not processed
rationale: UPF leaks a PFCP transaction if the Session Report Response is never processed; peer failure plausible but not shown.

rationale: Killed N3IWUE leaves an XFRM interface at the N3IWF so reconnection fails; failed party is a UE.
